# Test fixtures

`rar5-times.rar` and `rar3-subdirs.rar` are tiny sample archives from the
ISC-licensed `rarfile` Python project test corpus (https://github.com/markokr/rarfile).
They exist only to verify that the image can list and extract RAR4/RAR5 input
through `libarchive-tools` (bsdtar); the application never creates RAR files.
